verses.text: A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”

segments.text: A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”

verses.text: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.

segments.text: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.text: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,

verses.text: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.

verses.text: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.

segments.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.

verses.text: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”

verses.text: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”

verses.text: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
